'''Vorr''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] who was the brother of [[Vye]] and [[Vexx]]. He was killed by the future [[Hunter (individual)|Grand Champion of the Great Hunt]] on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|You killed our brother Vexx, you pile of scum! You got anything to say for yourself?|Vorr, to the [[Hunter (individual)|Hunter]]|<ref name="TOR:PA" />}}
{{GameDSmechanics}}
Trying to get his competitor killed, [[Tarro Blood]] convinced Vorr and his sister, Vye, that the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who killed Vexx shot him in the back and then murdered [[Braden]]. Along with Vye, Vorr confronted the hunter in the [[Sobrik]] [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]]. In the ensuing firefight, the hunter proved better with a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] and killed the siblings.<ref name="TOR:PA" />
{{Endgame}}

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Vorr first appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. He appears on the planet Balmorra just after the bounty hunter lands. The player also has the "[[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]]" option of convincing Vorr of Tarro's deception, where he leaves the hunter alone. This article assumes the player chose the first "dark side" option.<ref name="TOR:PA" />
